theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (d : ℝ) (S : ℝ → Set (Euclid P)) (ψ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (δ ε : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) (B : ℝ≥0∞), (∀ k, Measurable (ψ k)) → Tendsto δ atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0) → (∀ k t, (⨅ (c : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)) (_ : S t ⊆ ⋃ i, c i) (_ : ∀ i, Metric.ediam (c i) ≤ δ k), ∑' i, ⨆ _ : (c i).Nonempty, Metric.ediam (c i) ^ d) ≤ ψ k t) → (∀ k, ∫⁻ t, ψ k t ≤ B + ε k) → ∃ φ : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable φ ∧ (∀ t, μH[d] (S t) ≤ φ t) ∧ ∫⁻ t, φ t ≤ B
